description: This file defines a custom implementation of the AuthenticationStateProvider for a Blazor application. It manages user authentication state by fetching user info from a web API, caching results to minimize calls, and constructing ClaimsPrincipal objects based on received user data.

classes.name: CustomAuthStateProvider
classes.description: A custom authentication state provider for Blazor applications that fetches and caches user authentication data from a web API.

methods.name: GetAuthenticationStateAsync
methods.description: Overridden method that returns the current authentication state, utilizing caching for efficiency.

methods.name: GetUser
methods.description: Retrieves the user information, either from cache or by fetching fresh data from the API.

methods.name: FetchUser
methods.description: Makes an HTTP request to get the user data and constructs a ClaimsPrincipal based on the response.
